d: The Dahua DHI-ASC3202B is a network access controller supporting up to two doors with flexible one-way or two-way access control. It supports multiple authentication methods including card, fingerprint, password, Bluetooth, and remote access. Designed for commercial and enterprise deployments, it features TCP/IP connectivity, PoE support, alarm interfaces, and integration with Dahua access management systems.

specs.label: Internet Protocol
specs.value: P2P; IPv4; DNS; DDNS; TCP; UDP

specs.label: Unlock Mode
specs.value: Card; remote; password; fingerprint; Bluetooth; combination unlock

specs.label: Peripheral Card Reader
specs.value: Supports 2 × RS-485 card readers; 2 × Wiegand card readers
